name: Originality
measures: How far a draft is from stock phrasing and from the reference posts it was inspired by.
limitations: Only compares against reference texts you pass with --refs. It has no idea what else exists on Instagram.
Low overlap is not the same as a fresh idea. An unoriginal idea in new words still scores well.
Cliche detection is a word list.

rules.fix: Replace stock phrases with what you actually mean.

rules.why: Template constructions ('not just X, but Y').

criteria.label: Distance from references
criteria.measures: Word-sequence overlap with the inspiration posts.

rules.why: 4-word sequences shared with a reference. Above ~0.2 reads as a rewrite.
rules.fix: Keep the structure, replace the wording and examples with your own.

criteria.label: Own specifics
criteria.measures: Concrete details only this creator would have.

rules.fix: Add a real detail from your own work.

dealbreakers.message: Half or more of the 4-word sequences match a reference. That is a copy.
